name: Easy Carousel
description: Simple carousel from a field of media.
project_description:
Easy Carousel! 
 The easy way to add a Carousel in your site...

 Features 
 Posibility to create a Carousel in a easy way. You can create a carousel using the existing Media items or simply create a plain carousels.

You can customize a lot of carousel properties, like display/or not controls, indicators, height, transition speed, colors... 

 Carousel Types 
 By default, there are three types of carousel blocks:

 
 Simple carousel (with media in top and content in bottom) 
 Bootstrap carousel (style with bootstrap library) 
 Brands carousel (an infinite scroll carousel, normally used to show brands, logos, etc.) 
 Gallery carousel 
 
 Export/Import carousels 
 You can export your carousels and carousel items in a zipped file to make a backup. This zip file could be imported later.

ATTENTION: When you import a zip file, all existent carousels and items will be deleted.

 Instructions 
 
 Create the carousel items under Content->Carousels Items and customize them. 
 Create a new carousel entity under Content->Carousels and add the items that appears in the carousel. 
 Add a new Easy Carousel Block in the desired region, choose the created carousel and configure all the properties (speed, height, etc...). 
 
 That's all!
